plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: the stacked logo sits alone as a brand signature on the far left, a wide left-aligned copy column holds the headline down through the badge row (Reserve a Seat leading), with the legal line under it, and the book closes the read on the right at full height.

Lead with the product: the book is anchored full height on the left, the copy column and badge/CTA row read rightward from it, and the logo closes the line on the far right as a sign-off, with the legal line running along the bottom.

Headline-first band: a wide text block across the top two-thirds lets the headline run large on one line, with a lower row that pairs the badge/CTA group with the logo underneath it, and the book filling the right edge.
